methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The technical, business and organizational possibilities as well as the involvement of personnel along the McKinsey 7S model are considered. McKinsey's 7S change management tool provides the framework.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Energy-management implementation framework without a characterised EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: TIEM methodology provides a comprehensive model for the implementation of energy management. All aspects of an organization are considered in this methodology.

stage1.notes: TIEM structures EnMS implementation around 7S; indicator categories are mentioned but no EnPI/EnB model is identified or characterised.
